svg.title: Strategy · ACA subsidy wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / STRATEGY / ACA
Income cap at the cliff: $1 above 400% FPL removes the subsidy.
Strategy target: cap income at 400% FPL to keep the subsidy.
The cliff is a step, not a slope. The engine applies the FPL rule for the year.
Repayment appears in the next-year tax balance.
Adjust drawdown to hold the cap
Below 138% FPL the plan is assumed
Benchmark premium, subsidy, and net premium are separate values. The subsidy is a dollar amount, not a percentage
The FPL cliff is a step at 400%. Above it the subsidy is reduced or removed, and the chart shows the drop.
An advance credit reconciled against final MAGI creates a repayment in the next-year tax balance.
A strategy targeting 400% FPL caps income below the cliff; the engine adjusts drawdown, not the client.
